newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends weaker as locals sell, trade thin.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends weaker as locals sell, trade thin.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures ended the week lower as light local selling nudged the market off recent highs, floor sources said.
Losses came after the most-active December reached a 13-week high of 77.90 on Wednesday. The contract hit 78.40 June 11.
The most-active December contract settled at 76.1984, off 0.6537, having ranged from 77.40 to 76.11. Spot October finished unchanged at 75.50, while the back months closed 0.55 lower to 0.05 higher.
Volume was estimated at only 6,000 lots.

Market sources noted talk of improvements in the crops in the Southeast and in California. Cold temperatures forecast for Texas are not expected to fall low enough to damage crops, and rain in the Delta has already begun to taper off, meteorologists said.
